type Scheduler interface
  embedded GoalScheduler
  method AcquireJobLease func(ctx context.Context, req JobLeaseRequest) (*LeaseSnapshot, error)
  method AcquireWork func(ctx context.Context, req WorkRequest) ([]LeaseSnapshot, error)

  method CompleteLease func(ctx context.Context, mutation CompletionMutation) (StoredJob, error)
  method CreateJob func(ctx context.Context, req CreateJobRequest) (StoredJob, error)
  method GetJob func(ctx context.Context, key github.com/colony-2/jobdb/pkg/jobdb.JobKey) (StoredJob, error)
  method GetSchedule func(ctx context.Context, key github.com/colony-2/jobdb/pkg/jobdb.ScheduleKey) (StoredSchedule, error)
  method GetWaitingTask func(ctx context.Context, key github.com/colony-2/jobdb/pkg/jobdb.JobKey) (WaitingTaskSnapshot, error)
  method KeepAliveLease func(ctx context.Context, mutation LeaseMutation) (LeaseSnapshot, error)
  method ListJobs func(ctx context.Context, req ListJobsRequest) (ListJobsResponse, error)
  method ListScheduleRuns func(ctx context.Context, req ListScheduleRunsRequest) (ListScheduleRunsResponse, error)
  method ListSchedules func(ctx context.Context, req ListSchedulesRequest) (ListSchedulesResponse, error)
  method MutateSchedule func(ctx context.Context, mutation ScheduleStateMutation) (StoredSchedule, error)
  method RescheduleLease func(ctx context.Context, mutation RescheduleMutation) (StoredJob, error)
  method UpsertSchedule func(ctx context.Context, mutation StoredScheduleMutation) (StoredSchedule, error)
  method ValidateLease func(ctx context.Context, identity LeaseIdentity) (LeaseSnapshot, error)

  field MaxInlineArtifactBytes int64
  field Logger *log/slog.Logger
  field WorkerID string
type EmbeddedRuntime struct
  field Runtime *Runtime
method EmbeddedRuntime.Shutdown func()
func New func(db *database/sql.DB, opts ...Option) (*Runtime, error)

var ErrInvalid error
var ErrTooLarge error

const MaxDepth untyped int = 128

  field Mode string `json:"mode"`
  field Value encoding/json.RawMessage `json:"value,omitempty"`
